purpose: Mechanism validation for P22A_SPR_ABS_15s_60s; no strategy or executable economics.

known_phase22a_observation.researcher_degree_of_freedom_warning: Phase 22B was designed after these aggregate Phase 22A results and diagnostics were visible. Its 2023 stage is internal temporal replication, not a pristine holdout.

sequence: Fit every control boundary and model transformation on 2019-2021 only.
Freeze development estimates, diagnostics, coefficients, classification inputs and exact survivor decision before opening 2022.
Apply the unchanged model and boundaries to 2022, then freeze its result before opening 2023.
Apply unchanged to 2023 as internal temporal replication; do not call it pristine or prospective.

causality.anchor: UTC epoch multiples of 10 seconds using the latest quote timestamp <= anchor with maximum age 2 seconds.
causality.current_mid: (bid_t + ask_t) / 2 at the eligible anchor quote.
causality.future_mid: latest eligible quote timestamp <= anchor+60s, strictly after anchor, age relative to horizon <=2s; never search after the horizon.
causality.trailing_window: (anchor-15s, anchor] for recent volatility, activity and impulse.
causality.spread_baseline: median spread of the preceding six eligible 10-second anchors, excluding current anchor.
causality.missingness: No interpolation, synthesis or forward fill across gaps; an unavailable feature or outcome makes only that estimand row ineligible.

exposure.name: spread_dislocation_state
exposure.contrast: WIDE=Phase22A frozen pair-specific discovery Q5; TIGHT=Phase22A frozen pair-specific discovery Q1; Q2-Q4 excluded from the primary contrast.
exposure.boundaries: Reuse exact Phase 22A 2019-2021 pair-specific boundaries; never refit or optimize.
exposure.effect_orientation: WIDE minus TIGHT. Negative movement effect means lower subsequent absolute movement in WIDE state.

primary_raw_pips.estimand: mean(WIDE)-mean(TIGHT), first within pair x UTC trading day and then equal-weighted across available pair-days

secondary_current_spread_units.role: mechanical-normalization diagnostic only; cannot establish a genuine phenomenon by itself

secondary_trailing_spread_units.role: denominator diagnostic independent of current spread

secondary_fixed_scale.definition: Y_RAW_ABS_60S_PIPS/pair-specific median current spread estimated once on 2019-2021 and frozen

controls.fit_rule: All numeric boundaries use pair-specific empirical quintiles estimated on 2019-2021 only and frozen for 2022/2023; no threshold search.
controls.recent_micro_volatility: sum absolute nonzero mid changes over (t-15s,t], in pips; retain continuous log1p value and frozen quintile.
controls.quote_activity: quote count over (t-15s,t] divided by one quarter of quote count over nonoverlapping (t-75s,t-15s]; retain continuous log1p ratio and frozen quintile; denominator zero is missing.
controls.time_of_day: fixed UTC hour categorical 0-23; weekday categorical Monday-Friday; no data-derived session boundaries.
controls.recent_directional_impulse: mid_t minus causal as-of mid at t-15s, in raw pips; encode sign {-1,0,+1} and frozen quintile of absolute magnitude.
controls.pair: fixed categorical EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, USDCAD; pooled estimates weight pair-days equally.

broader_liquidity_state.baseline_micro_volatility: sum absolute mid changes in (t-75s,t-15s] in pips

primary_hypotheses.alternative: The WIDE-minus-TIGHT effect for Y_RAW_ABS_60S_PIPS is negative, practically nontrivial and stable after frozen adjustment.
primary_hypotheses.null: The raw-pip contrast is nonnegative, practically trivial, unstable, or removed by pre-registered controls.

primary_hypotheses.alternative: The negative current-spread-unit contrast is materially larger than raw/fixed/trailing-scale contrasts because current spread is both exposure-defining and the denominator.
primary_hypotheses.null: The sign and practical magnitude persist in raw pips and denominator-independent scales.

primary_hypotheses.alternative: Recent micro-volatility and/or quote activity explain the raw effect or materially modify it.
primary_hypotheses.null: The adjusted raw effect retains sign, at least 50% magnitude and stability after both controls.

primary_hypotheses.alternative: Session/time or broader liquidity state explains or localizes the raw effect.
primary_hypotheses.null: The adjusted raw effect remains stable across fixed sessions and liquidity strata.

primary_hypotheses.alternative: Recent directional impulse explains or modifies the effect.
primary_hypotheses.null: Adjustment for impulse sign/magnitude preserves the raw effect.

primary_hypotheses.alternative: The effect is pair-specific or materially heterogeneous.
primary_hypotheses.null: At least three pairs share the pooled sign and no single pair dominates.

models_and_estimands.M0: Unadjusted pair-day WIDE-minus-TIGHT contrasts for each outcome.
models_and_estimands.M1: Raw-pip contrast adjusted for pair, UTC hour, weekday and fixed session indicators.
models_and_estimands.M2: M1 plus frozen-quintile and continuous terms for recent volatility and activity.
models_and_estimands.M3: M2 plus impulse sign and frozen absolute-impulse quintile.
models_and_estimands.M4: M3 plus trailing median spread, quote age, baseline quote rate and baseline volatility; current spread is excluded because it defines exposure.
models_and_estimands.estimation: Pre-specified ordinary least squares with pair and time fixed effects; Frisch-Waugh-Lovell residualization is algebraically equivalent and allowed. No regularization, feature selection, nonlinear fitting or ML.
models_and_estimands.weighting: Each eligible pair-day receives equal weight in pooled inference; report anchor-weighted estimates only as descriptive sensitivity.
models_and_estimands.attenuation: For models M1-M4, 1-abs(adjusted WIDE coefficient)/abs(M0 WIDE coefficient); if M0 is zero, attenuation is undefined and cannot support a confounding classification.

normalization_artifact_tests: Compare M0 WIDE-minus-TIGHT estimates and daily-block CIs for raw pips, current-spread units, trailing-spread units and fixed-discovery scale.
Compute denominator amplification ratio abs(delta_current_spread_units)/abs(delta_fixed_scale); undefined when fixed-scale contrast is zero.
Repeat current-spread-unit contrast after stratifying by frozen current-spread-pip quintile; require both WIDE and TIGHT observations in a pair-day stratum.
Fit the fixed M4 raw-pip model and separately report current-spread-unit M4 only as a diagnostic.
No alternative denominator, winsorization level or transform may be added after results are viewed.

inference.primary_unit: UTC trading-day block; pair-day estimates are the observations for pooled inference.
inference.bootstrap: Deterministic stratified resampling of UTC days with replacement within calendar year; all pairs for a sampled day travel together to preserve cross-pair dependence.
inference.p_values: Two-sided bootstrap sign-tail p-values; H_RAW additionally reports the pre-registered one-sided negative-direction p-value.
inference.multiple_testing: H_RAW is the single primary test and is not multiplicity-adjusted. Apply Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.05 across the seven interaction families and separately across the six confounder-attribution families H_NORMALIZATION, H_VOLATILITY_ACTIVITY, H_SESSION_LIQUIDITY, H_IMPULSE, H_PAIR and H_MIXED diagnostics.
inference.permutation_diagnostic: Within each pair-day, permute WIDE/TIGHT labels within fixed UTC-hour x volatility-quintile x activity-quintile strata, 10000 permutations, seed 22003; diagnostic only.
inference.missing_cell_rule: Do not impute. A contrast cell needs at least 20 eligible anchors per exposure group; a pair-day needs both groups; report attrition before inference.
inference.software_determinism: Stable timestamp sorting, fixed seeds, canonical JSON and SHA-256 for every stage.

effect_size_and_stability.raw_pip_minimum: A genuine effect requires pooled adjusted WIDE-minus-TIGHT <= -0.05 pips at 60 seconds and a 95% CI wholly below zero in each advancement stage.
effect_size_and_stability.retention_after_adjustment: M4 magnitude must be at least 50% of M0 and retain the negative sign.
effect_size_and_stability.pair_stability: Negative adjusted sign in at least 3 of 4 pairs; no one pair may exceed 50% of summed absolute pair effects.
effect_size_and_stability.development_year_stability: Negative adjusted sign separately in 2019, 2020 and 2021.
effect_size_and_stability.temporal_replication: Unchanged negative adjusted sign, <=-0.05 pips and CI below zero in 2022 and separately in 2023.
effect_size_and_stability.session_stability: Report every fixed session. Genuine classification requires negative sign in at least three of asian, london_pre_overlap, overlap and new_york_post_overlap; off_session is descriptive.
effect_size_and_stability.concentration: Top five UTC days <50% of total absolute daily effect and largest month <50% of summed absolute month effects.

confounding_rules.material_attenuation: A control block materially confounds when its addition causes >=50% attenuation versus the immediately preceding model, or reverses sign, and the adjusted CI includes zero or violates the -0.05 pip minimum in both 2022 and 2023.
confounding_rules.partial_attenuation: 25% to <50% attenuation with retained sign is evidence for a mixed mechanism, not full explanation.
confounding_rules.interaction_evidence: An interaction family matters only if BH-FDR survives and the exposure effect fails the frozen stability requirement in at least one prespecified stratum in both 2022 and 2023.
confounding_rules.pair_specific: Fewer than 3 pairs retain negative adjusted sign, or one pair contributes >=50% of summed absolute pair effects, consistently in 2022 and 2023.

terminal_classification_algorithm.rule: H_RAW passes every effect-size/stability stage; M4 retains >=50% of M0; denominator-independent raw, trailing and fixed-scale effects have the negative sign; no full-confounder rule passes.

GENUINE fails; current-spread-unit contrast is negative with CI below zero in 2022 and 2023, while raw-pip M0/M4 is nonnegative or >-0.05 or its CI includes zero, both denominator-independent contrasts fail the negative requirement, and denominator amplification ratio is >=4 in both stages.
GENUINE and NORMALIZATION_ARTIFACT fail; adding the frozen volatility/activity block meets material_attenuation and its interaction family survives FDR in both 2022 and 2023.
Prior states fail; session/time or broader-liquidity block meets material_attenuation or the effect fails session stability, with the corresponding interaction surviving FDR in both 2022 and 2023.
Prior states fail and the frozen pair_specific criterion holds in both 2022 and 2023.
No single prior explanation is sufficient; two or more blocks each show partial_attenuation or replicating FDR-significant interactions, while some negative raw effect remains.
None of the preceding states is supported, required stages/cells are inadequate, signs fail to replicate, or inference is invalid.

advancement_and_rejection.advance_to_2022: 2019-2021 implementation passes leakage/QA; H_RAW and all mechanism diagnostics are complete and frozen. Mechanism candidates are not selected or changed; all pre-registered tests advance unchanged.
advancement_and_rejection.advance_to_2023: 2022 artifact is complete, hash-frozen and independently validated; no definitions, models, thresholds, directions or classifications changed.
advancement_and_rejection.phase22b_success: Only GENUINE_SPREAD_STATE_PHENOMENON may be called a confirmed genuine mechanism candidate. Other classifications are informative closures and do not authorize strategy work.
advancement_and_rejection.reject_genuine_claim: Any raw-pip minimum, CI, temporal, pair, session, concentration or adjustment-retention criterion fails.
advancement_and_rejection.insufficient_evidence: Missing required cells, lineage/hash mismatch, leakage, non-reproducible bootstrap, or unauthorized partition access yields PHENOMENON_NOT_CONFIRMED or INVALID_RUN; never threshold repair.

leakage_tests: Every feature and control timestamp is <= anchor; future quote is >anchor and <=anchor+60s with frozen freshness.
Trailing 15-second features exclude future ticks; baseline window is nonoverlapping and ends at anchor-15s.
Current spread and causal trailing median exclude future quotes and the current anchor is excluded from its own baseline.
All quintile boundaries and fixed scales are fit using 2019-2021 only; serialized hashes are unchanged in 2022/2023.
2022 cannot be opened before the development mechanism artifact is frozen; 2023 cannot be opened before 2022 is frozen.
No file whose timestamps reach 2024-01-01 is enumerated, sampled, counted, hashed or read.
Perturbing ticks after an anchor cannot change its exposure, controls or current denominators.
Perturbing 2022/2023 cannot change development boundaries, formulas, model matrix or classification rules.
Duplicate timestamps are stable-sorted and handled by the existing frozen quote ordering; missing/gap rows are never filled.
Input dataset root, Phase 22A evidence hashes and candidate ID must match before execution.
required_reporting: Anchor and pair-day attrition by reason, pair, year and month.
M0-M4 raw-pip coefficients, CIs, attenuation and daily distributions.
All four outcome scales side by side; never omit raw pips.
Pair, year, month, weekday, session/hour and liquidity-stratum stability.
Every interaction test, raw and FDR-adjusted p-value, including rejections.
Deterministic terminal classification with every rule truth value.
prohibited: threshold optimization or post-result threshold introduction
new horizons, lookbacks, pairs, sessions, outcomes, controls or interactions after freeze
strategy construction, BUY/SELL rules, entries, exits, stops or targets
PnL, commissions, slippage, expectancy or position sizing
machine learning or data-driven feature selection
2024+ access, order APIs or broker execution
